props.name: count
props.description: Items to make with `renderItem`, when not passing children.

props.name: width
props.description: Coordinate box the path is written in; the element keeps its ratio.

props.name: radius
props.description: Circle and arc radius. Defaults to fit the box, less `inset`.

props.name: inset
props.description: Room kept between a circle or arc and the box edge.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Arc angles in degrees; 0 points right, -90 up.

props.name: angle
props.description: `shape="line"` direction in degrees; 0 runs left to right.

props.name: points
props.description: A polyline, for `shape="points"`; `smooth` rounds its corners.

props.name: justify
props.description: Defaults to `between`, or `start` once a `gap` is set.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between items along the path, in box units, when packed.

props.name: offset
props.description: Shifts every item along the path, as a share of its length (0 to 1).

props.name: orient
props.description: Turns each item to follow the path's direction.

props.name: showPath
props.description: Draws the guide path under the items.
